description: This file is a PHP class definition for the 'Cod' payment extension in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods to display the configuration page and save settings for the cash-on-delivery payment method.

classes.name: Cod
classes.description: Controller class for handling the configuration of the Cash on Delivery (COD) payment method in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for the COD payment method, including breadcrumbs, current settings, and loading necessary view components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to save the COD payment method settings, validates permissions, saves data, and returns a JSON response.
